exploration.title: Exploration & Goal Packet System Redesign
openQuestions: Amendment J (D22) lands in the existing @beep/skill-contract kernel, so no packet owns it: does the completed skill-contract-kernel packet reopen for a v2, does candidate 6 carry it as a rung, or does it open as its own goal packet?

What is candidate 6's first vertical slice: the fork-repair applier alone (Amendment G rung 0 against the committed fork fixture, lifting the opt-in freeze), or the applier plus the first migration wave so the translator's shape is proven against real half-migrated manifests before the fleet sees it?
